tips.title: Define the CoordSys position for the Multiaxis machining.
tips.body: Set the coordinate system (CoordSys) to specify the origin and orientation of the tool path.

tips.title: Define Coordinate System
tips.body: Choose a coordinate system from the combo-box or select it graphically by clicking 'define'. The CoordSys Manager dialog box will display.

tips.title: Set MAC Number
tips.body: The MAC Number defines the number of the Coordinate System in the CNC-Machine. The default value is 1.

tips.title: Edit Coordinate System
tips.body: Use the CoordSys dialog box to change the location or orientation of the axes.

tips.title: Define Work Plane
tips.body: Choose the default work plane for operations in the Geometry page: XY, YZ, or ZX.

tips.title: Define Machining Surfaces
tips.body: Select the icon to display the Select Faces dialog box for defining new geometry or edit existing geometry.

tips.title: Define Floor Surfaces
tips.body: Floor surfaces must cover all the area above the area to be machined.

tips.title: Define Ceiling Surfaces
tips.body: Ceiling surfaces must cover all the underneath area to be machined and should not have any gaps.

tips.title: Define Wall Surfaces
tips.body: Wall surfaces must be the whole part including the floor surface, excluding the ceiling surface.

tips.title: Define Stock
tips.body: Select the Respect stock model check box to update the stock 3D model. Define stock using STL, surfaces, or 2D boundary.

tips.title: Set tolerance value for tool deviation
tips.body: Tolerance value can be set in the Geometry section.

tips.title: Expand or shrink stock model
tips.body: Use Shrink/Expand options to adjust stock size.

tips.title: Identify undercut areas in stock
tips.body: Enable the 'Stock has undercuts' option to optimize roughing strategy.

tips.title: Select tool for operation
tips.body: Choose a tool from the TOOLKIT table on the Tool page.

tips.title: Consider tool holder shape during path calculation
tips.body: Enable 'Check with machining surfaces' and 'Check with in-process stock' to avoid collisions.

tips.title: Define tool feed in F or FZ units
tips.body: Feed can be defined in Units per minute (F) or Units per tooth (FZ).

tips.title: Calculate FZ based on feed and number of flutes
tips.body: FZ = F / (Number of Flutes * S)

tips.title: Define spinning speed in S or V units
tips.body: Spin can be defined in Revolutions per Minute (S) or material cutting speed (V).

tips.title: Calculate V based on spin and tool diameter
tips.body: V = (S * PI * Tool Diameter) / 1000

tips.title: Define spin direction
tips.body: Choose between clockwise (CW) or counterclockwise (CCW).

tips.title: Define length offset number
tips.body: Set the number of Length Offset Register in the Offset table.

tips.title: Update cutting conditions for CNC machine
tips.body: Click 'Cutting conditions' to update settings based on the current tool and CNC machine.

tips.title: Define feed control parameters
tips.body: Click 'Feed Control tab' to set parameters for controlling the feed rate.

tips.title: Optimize feed rate based on surface curvature
tips.body: Enable 'Feed Rate Optimization' to adjust feed rate according to the surface curvature.

tips.title: Replace rapid movements with non-rapid ones
tips.body: Enable 'Rapid motion in Feed mode' to replace G0 commands with non-rapid ones using a particular feed rate.

tips.title: Change feed rate at first cutting path
tips.body: Enable 'First cut feed, %' to change the feed rate at the first cutting path.

tips.title: Define minimum feed rate for contour
tips.body: Enable 'Min feed rate %' to set the minimum feed rate of the contour.

tips.title: Define feed rates for direct/spline links
tips.body: Set determined feed rates for direct and spline links in the Feed rate for direct/spline links section.

tips.title: Define safety distance for approach and retract
tips.body: Set the Retract distance, Safety distance, and Exit safety distance in the Levels page.

tips.title: Define arc fit for sharp angles
tips.body: Enable 'Arc fit' to fit an arc at moves that go to the Retract distance and Safety distance.

tips.title: Define clearance area types
tips.body: Choose from Automatic, Plane, Cylinder, or Sphere based on machining strategy and part geometry.

tips.title: Set clearance area plane direction
tips.body: Define the direction of the plane normal vector using X-Axis, Y-Axis, Z-Axis, or User-defined vector.

tips.title: Specify clearance area plane height
tips.body: Set the height of tool retraction using Automatic or User-defined value.

tips.title: Define clearance area as cylinder
tips.body: Set the direction and radius of the cylindrical surface enclosing the drive surface.

tips.title: Define clearance area as sphere
tips.body: Set the radius and center location of the spherical shape enclosing the drive surface.

tips.title: Set retract and safety distances
tips.body: Define the Retract and Safety distance to approach and retract from the part.

tips.title: Use constraint boundaries for machining limits
tips.body: Limit machining to specific model areas using created automatically, manually, or user-defined boundaries.

tips.title: Define boundary type for constraint boundaries
tips.body: Choose from Created automatically, Manually, or User-defined based on the machining requirements.

tips.title: Set tool-boundary relation for constraint boundaries
tips.body: Control how the tool is positioned relative to the boundaries using External, Internal, or Center options.

tips.title: Define surface quality parameters for radial roughing
tips.body: Set cut tolerance, step down, maximum step over, scallop, desired step over, climb step over (%), conventional step over (%), and adaptive clearance.

tips.title: Define surface quality parameters for wall/floor finishing
tips.body: Set cut tolerance and maximum stepdown.

tips.title: Define sorting parameters for radial roughing
tips.body: Set the order and direction of the cuts.

tips.title: Define cutting method for multiaxis machining
tips.body: Choose between Zigzag and One Way. Zigzag changes direction, One Way maintains same direction.

tips.title: Select machining order for multiaxis operations
tips.body: Choose between Levels and Regions for machining order.

tips.title: Configure undercut machining for radial roughing
tips.body: Choose between Do not machine, Machine, and Machine only options.

tips.title: Adjust adaptive stepdown for radial roughing
tips.body: Choose between First Stepdown, Final Stepdown, and User-defined cut levels.

tips.title: Distribute intermediate slices in tool path
tips.body: Choose between Constant Stepdown or Number of slices.

tips.title: Smooth corners and links in tool path
tips.body: Enable Smooth corners, Smooth final contour, and Smooth links options.

tips.title: Filter small pockets and segments in tool path
tips.body: Choose between Inscribed circle or Diagonal length for filtering type.

tips.title: Calculate rest rough tool path for radial roughing
tips.body: Enter Previous tool diameter and corner radius or select the tool manually.

tips.title: Control contact point height for wall or floor finishing
tips.body: Choose between Preferred, Minimal, and Maximal options.

tips.title: Define ramping parameters for radial roughing
tips.body: Choose between Ramp angle, Ramp type, and Ramp length.

tips.title: Set minimum ramp diameter based on tool size
tips.body: Select 'Min. ramp diameter (tool diameter %)' to limit the minimum diameter of ramping movements to a specified value, which should be a percentage of the tool diameter.

tips.title: Define stock clearance for ramping movements
tips.body: Set 'Stock clearance' to specify the minimum distance from the tool to the stock during ramping movements.

tips.title: Allow tool outside stock for machining
tips.body: Check 'Allow tool outside stock' when using the Offset strategy on the Geometry page to enable machining around the part and on the outer side of the stock if they have the same dimensions.

tips.title: Define ramping priority sequence for approach moves
tips.body: On the Geometry page, select 'Ramping priority sequence' when using the Offset strategy to specify the order of ramp types during approach moves creation.

tips.title: Define first entry approach parameters
tips.body: In the First entry section, specify whether to use retract distance or safety distance for the initial approach movement.

tips.title: Use ramp for first entry approach
tips.body: Check 'Use ramp/Don’t use ramp' in the First entry section to enable or disable the use of a ramp during the initial approach movement.

tips.title: Define home position for tool path linking
tips.body: Set 'Home position' to specify the coordinates of the home position used in tool path linking for first entry and last exit.

tips.title: Define last exit retreat parameters
tips.body: In the Last exit section, specify whether to use retract distance or safety distance for the final retreat movement.

tips.title: Use ramp for last exit retreat
tips.body: Check 'Use ramp/Don’t use ramp' in the Last exit section to enable or disable the use of a ramp during the final retreat movement.

tips.title: Define connection moves between passes in the same group
tips.body: In the Within group list, select the type of connection move (Direct, Blend spline, Retract to feed distance, Retract to rapid distance) for connections within a single group.

tips.title: Define connection moves between different groups in the same region
tips.body: In the Between groups list, select the type of connection move (Direct, Blend spline, Retract to feed distance, Retract to rapid distance) for connections between different groups within a single region.

tips.title: Define connection moves between cutting layers on multiple heights
tips.body: In the Links between slices section, select the type of connection move (Direct, Blend spline, Step, Retract to feed distance, Retract to rapid distance) for connections between different cutting layers.

tips.title: Define connection moves between different machining regions
tips.body: In the Links between regions section, select the type of connection move (Direct, Blend spline, Retract to feed distance, Retract to rapid distance) for connections between different machining regions.

tips.title: Use ramp for first entry in wall or floor finishing
tips.body: Check 'Use ramp/Don’t use ramp' when using the Wall or Floor Finishing technology to enable or disable the use of a ramp during the initial approach movement.

tips.title: Define link types for gouge check
tips.body: In the Link page, select the type of link (Retract to clearance area, Clearance blend spline) for collision checking during wall or floor finishing.

tips.title: Set check surfaces offset for gouge check
tips.body: In the Gouge check page, set 'Check surfaces offset' to specify the surface offset value for collision checking during wall or floor finishing.

tips.title: Define clearance offsets for tool components
tips.body: In the Clearance data page, specify the clearance values for Shaft, Arbor, and Holder to ensure a guaranteed clearance gap between the arbor, tool holder, and workpiece.

tips.title: Optimize tool path according to machine kinematics
tips.body: In the Machine control page, adjust parameters like angle pairs and machine limits to optimize the calculated tool path based on your CNC-Machine's kinematics and special characteristics.

tips.title: Automatically choose angle pair with minimal angle change
tips.body: Check 'Minimum angle change' in the Angle pairs section to automatically select an angle pair that minimizes the angle deviation from the previous tool axis orientation.

tips.title: Specify control over the first angle pair solution
tips.body: In the Start angle type option, choose between 'Choose between two solutions' or 'Provide first rotation angle' to define how the first angle pair is selected during tool path generation.

tips.title: Set second rotation angle for better tool path optimization
tips.body: InventorCAM chooses an angle pair where the second rotation angle is closer to the Rotation angle value parameter.

tips.title: Configure machine limits for tool path control
tips.body: Options include No limits, Translation limits, Rotation limits, and Limits All. Machine limits are checked using the Angle tolerance for using machine limits parameter.

tips.title: Handle pole areas in 5-axis machining
tips.body: Methods include Freeze Angle around Pole, Use Rotation Angle around Pole to stay within linear axis limits, Linear interpolation of Rotation Angle around Pole, and Smooth interpolation of Rotation Angle around Pole.

tips.title: Set angle limits for output tool paths
tips.body: Options include No limits, Limit between 0 and 360 deg, and Limit between -180 and 180 deg.

tips.title: Control angular tool movements in calculated tool path
tips.body: Parameters include Angle change, Retract distance, and Retract tool to maximum.

tips.title: Interpolate points for linear tool movements
tips.body: Options include Interpolation for distance and Interpolation angle step.

tips.title: Limit rotation angle for machine head
tips.body: Using Max. angle step for rotation axis parameter to limit the rotation angle measured from the last tool path point.

tips.body: Choose the appropriate geometry from the list or define a new one by clicking on the Select Faces dialog box.

tips.title: Define the Drive Surface Offset
tips.body: Set the machining allowance for the drive surface by defining a three-dimensional offset.

tips.title: Define the Work Type for Parallel Cuts
tips.body: Choose between Linear and Constant Z work types to define how tool path cuts are generated.

tips.title: Define the Edge Curve for Parallel to Curves Strategy
tips.body: Use the Geometry Edit dialog box to define a lead curve for operations using the Parallel to curves strategy.

tips.title: Define the Edge Surface for Parallel to Surface Strategy
tips.body: Generate the tool path on the drive surface parallel to a specified check surface using the Parallel to surface strategy.

tips.title: Use ball-nosed tools with tool center based calculation
tips.body: When using a ball-nosed tool, select the 'Tool center based calculation' option to ensure correct tool path generation.

tips.title: Activate gouge checking for parallel surface strategy
tips.body: For the Parallel to Surface strategy, activate gouge checking to prevent tool damage.

tips.title: Use advanced options for parallel surface strategy
tips.body: Access advanced options by clicking the 'Advanced' button to customize tool path generation.

tips.title: Consider normals for tool path generation
tips.body: When using the Generate tool path front side option, consider the check surface normals for more accurate paths.

tips.title: Adjust tool path tangent angle for parallel surface strategy
tips.body: Change the Single edge tool path tangent angle parameter to control the extension direction of passes.

tips.title: Use lead curve for perpendicular to curve strategy
tips.body: For the Perpendicular to Curve strategy, define a lead curve to generate tool paths orthogonal to it.

tips.title: Ensure lead curve is above drive surface
tips.body: For the Perpendicular to Curve strategy, place the lead curve exactly on or above the drive surface.

tips.title: Use start and end edge curves for morph strategy
tips.body: For the Morph between Two Boundary Curves strategy, define start and end edge curves to create a morphed tool path.

tips.title: Activate gouge checking for morph strategy
tips.body: For the Morph between Two Adjacent Surfaces strategy, activate gouge checking to prevent tool damage.

tips.title: Consider normals for morph strategy
tips.body: When using the Generate tool path front side option in Morph between Two Adjacent Surfaces, consider check surface normals.

tips.title: Adjust tangent angles for morph strategy
tips.body: Change the First surface tool path tangent angle and Second surface tool path tangent angle to control pass extension.

tips.title: Define projection curves for projection strategy
tips.body: For the Projection strategy, define the curves to generate a single tool path along them.

tips.title: Adjust projection distance for projection strategy
tips.body: Compensate for CAD tolerance issues by setting the Maximal projection distance value.

tips.title: Define direction for projection curves
tips.body: Specify the direction of projection using X, Y, Z axes, a line, or surface normal.

tips.title: Define center point for radial/spiral passes
tips.body: Set the position of a center point manually or automatically to generate radial/spiral passes.

tips.title: Define start and end points for radial passes
tips.body: Use the Start and End options to define the inner and outer circles for radial passes.

tips.title: Define angle for radial passes
tips.body: Use the Angle option to define an area based on two angles for tool path calculation in Projection (Radial) technology.

tips.title: Define cutting area on drive surface
tips.body: Specify the cutting area using options like Full, avoid cuts at exact edges, or Limit cuts by one or two points.

tips.title: Tool path starts and ends at exact surface edges
tips.body: Ensure that surface edges are perfectly trimmed to avoid unnecessary air movements during machining.

tips.title: Define margins for tool path calculation
tips.body: Margins can be defined for the drive surface edges to control where the machining starts and finishes.

tips.title: Use additional margin to overcome surface edge inaccuracies
tips.body: The Additional margin parameter compensates for inaccuracy in the CAD model edges.

tips.title: Limit cuts by one or two points
tips.body: Define limiting points using the Limit Cuts Between 2 Points dialog box to limit tool path.

tips.title: Limit cuts by number of cuts
tips.body: Set the Number of cuts parameter to limit the tool path by a specific number of cutting passes.

tips.title: Define margins for Morph between two adjacent surfaces
tips.body: Margins can be defined to shift the first cut location when using the Morph between two adjacent surfaces strategy.

tips.title: Use 2D boundary for machining limitation
tips.body: Define a planar boundary to limit the machining area, which is projected onto the model.

tips.title: Fixture collision protection option
tips.body: Automatically adjust the tool path to avoid contact between the setup and selected tool.

tips.title: Define spin and feed parameters for tools
tips.body: Set the Spin and Feed parameters in the Tool page to define tool behavior during machining.

tips.title: Define feed zone control parameters
tips.body: Set the Feed Zone Control parameters to optimize feed rate based on surface curvature.

tips.title: Define feed rate for flat tool path segments
tips.body: Feed rate is defined as a percentage of the defined Feed Rate of the cutting movements.

tips.title: Replace rapid movements with non-rapid ones
tips.body: InventorCAM replaces all rapid movements (G0) with non-rapid ones using a particular feed rate when the Rapid motion in G1 mode check box is selected.

tips.title: Optimize first cut feed rate
tips.body: The First cut feed, % option enables you to change the feed rate at the first cutting path in order to optimize the cutting process.

tips.title: Control tool path feed rate by contact point
tips.body: The Tool contact based feed rate optimization option enables you to control the tool path feed rate by the actual contact point of the surface and the contact point of the tool that defines the engagement radius.

tips.title: Define clearance area type
tips.body: Depending on the drive surface or your machining strategy, you can choose different clearance area types: Automatic, Plane, Cylinder, Sphere.

tips.title: Set clearance area height
tips.body: The Height section provides options to determine the height of tool retraction. When the option of Automatic is selected, InventorCAM automatically determines the position and dimension of the clearance plane.

tips.title: Define cylinder clearance area
tips.body: The Cylinder option enables to define the Clearance area as a cylindrical surface enclosing the Drive surface.

tips.title: Define sphere clearance area
tips.body: The Sphere option enables to define the Clearance area as a spherical surface enclosing the Drive surface.

tips.title: Set retract distance
tips.body: In the Clearance area, the tool turns to the final orientation for the first cut. After the rotation, the tool performs a rapid descent movement to the level specified by the Retract distance parameter.

tips.title: Set safety distance
tips.body: After the descent movement to the Retract distance level, the tool starts the approach movement to the material.

tips.title: Perform rapid retract with rapid feed
tips.body: When this check box is selected, the retract movement is performed with rapid feed.

tips.title: Define rapid distance in tool plane
tips.body: When the Rapid distance in tool plane parameter is selected, the tool retracts along its plane until it reaches the rapid distance plane height.

tips.title: Fit arc to sharp angles
tips.body: InventorCAM enables you to fit an arc to sharp angles.

tips.title: Keep initial orientation until distance
tips.body: When the Keep initial orientation until distance check box is selected, the tool descends not tilted, parallel to the vector normal to the plane.

tips.title: Define distance for tool orientation change
tips.body: The Distance parameter defines the distance to/from the beginning of the link movement, at which the tool orientation changes.

tips.title: Control interpolation tilt angles for clearance plane
tips.body: The Angle step for rapid moves parameter defines the angle increments for the tool tilting.

tips.title: Define surface quality parameters
tips.body: The Cut tolerance parameter defines the tool path accuracy, affecting the chordal deviation between the machining surface and the tool path.

tips.title: Set point spacing parameters for tool path
tips.body: The Distance parameter defines the number of tool path points on a surface, with varying distances based on surface curvature.

tips.title: Define maximum step over for cutting operations
tips.body: The Maximum step over parameter defines the maximum distance between two consecutive cuts, varying by machining strategy.

tips.title: Adjust scallop parameter for ball nose mill
tips.body: The Scallop parameter defines the cusp height of the machined surface, available only with Ball Nose Mill tools.

tips.title: Enable adaptive cuts for better surface quality
tips.body: The Adaptive cuts check box enables adjusting step over between tool path passes to ensure acceptable distance between adjacent passes.

tips.title: Define cutting method for tool path generation
tips.body: The Cutting method option enables defining how cuts are connected, with choices of One Way, Zigzag, and Spiral.

tips.title: Set direction of machining for One Way and Spiral options
tips.body: The CCW for closed cuts option enables performing the machining in the counterclockwise direction.

tips.title: Define contact point based cutting directions for climb and conventional milling
tips.body: The Contact point based cutting directions check box allows selecting All contours or Single contour from the list.

tips.title: Define machining order for Sim. 5-axis operations
tips.body: Use the Machine by list to choose between Lanes or Regions for machining order.

tips.title: Enforce direction of machining for open contours
tips.body: Select the Enforce direction of machining check box to enforce cutting direction in open tool paths.

tips.title: Flip step over for closed contours
tips.body: Use the Flip Step over option to reverse machining direction from top of model to edge.

tips.title: Define start point for tool path
tips.body: Use the Start point option to define a new position of the start point along a cut.

tips.title: Surface normal direction for start point
tips.body: Choose Surface normal direction to locate the start point at the intersection of the tool path with a user-defined vector.

tips.title: Cutting side for tool path
tips.body: Position the tool at Center, Left, or Right side of the tool path using the Cutting side parameter.

tips.title: Modify tool path parameters
tips.body: Use the Modify tab to define parameters affecting the tool path, such as Surface edge merge distance.

tips.title: Apply outer sharp corners for machining
tips.body: Enable Apply outer sharp corners to preserve the sharpness of adjacent outer edges during machining.

tips.title: Define parameters for corner looping
tips.body: Set Outer angle along pass and Loops radius to define the conditions for corner looping.

tips.title: Use 3D tool compensation for tool path
tips.body: Enable 3D tool compensation to use CNC-controller options in GCode, recalculating the tool path according to a formula.

tips.title: Smooth tool path for sharp corners
tips.body: Enable Smooth toolpath to replace sharp corners with splines, controlled by Smoothing and Detection Angle parameters.

tips.title: Round corners to avoid fish tail movements
tips.body: Use the Round corners option to generate a smoother tool path in sharp corners or small radius areas.

tips.title: Define cutting area by surface inclination angle
tips.body: Use the Angle range button to define shallow and steep areas for machining based on surface inclination angles.

tips.title: Extend or trim tool path tangentially
tips.body: Use the Extend/Trim button to extend or trim the tool path tangentially along cuts, defined by distances and percentages.

tips.title: Enable side extensions for extended machining area
tips.body: Check 'Side extentions' and set distances either by values or percentage of tool diameter. Positive values extend passes, negative values trim passes.

tips.title: Apply extending/trimming to gaps during tool path linking
tips.body: Check 'Extend/trim gaps' and specify distances for extending or trimming in the Start/End sections.

tips.title: Use 'One way' option for correct tool path with Zigzag
tips.body: Select 'One way' option when using Zigzag to avoid reversing start and end points of passes.

tips.title: Define tool axis orientation for 4-axis operations
tips.body: Go to 'Tool axis control' > 'Regular' tab and select 'Output format' as '4 Axis'. Define rotary axis orientation using the 4th Axis dialog box.

tips.title: Set fifth axis angle for 5-axis operations
tips.body: Go to 'Tool axis control' > 'Regular' tab and select 'Output format' as '5 Axis'. Set the fifth axis angle using the 'Locked at angle' parameter.

tips.title: Limit tool tilting along the tool path
tips.body: Go to 'Tool axis control' > 'Regular' tab and click 'Limits' button to define angle range parameters for XZ, YZ, XY planes or conical limits.

tips.title: Smooth tool path for better cutting flow
tips.body: Go to 'Tool axis control' > 'Regular' tab and click 'Smoothing' button to enable smoothing in the cutting direction using Global, Relative to cutting direction or Relative to rotary axis options.

tips.title: Use automatic tilting for collision control with barrel shaped tools
tips.body: On the 'Gouge check page', set Strategy to 'Tilt tool > Automatic' and select 'Affected toolpath' option for collision control.

tips.title: Set side tilt by angle or contact point
tips.body: Choose Angle to set side tilt angle and define tool contact point using algorithm. Choose Contact point to align tool tangentially at specified contact point.

tips.title: Define lag angle to cutting direction
tips.body: Lag angle to cutting direction parameter enables tool tilting in the direction of cutting pass, measured relative to surface normal.

tips.title: Use contact point definition by height or line parameter
tips.body: Contact point can be defined by height (distance from tool tip to contact point in tool axis direction) or by line parameter (distance along tool profile).

tips.title: Define side tilt fanning distance
tips.body: Side tilt fanning distance parameter controls side tool tilting direction at the intersection of two surfaces with different isometric directions.

tips.title: Change lag angle gradually along tool path
tips.body: Gradual lag angle change enables changing the lag angle for each cutting pass, with final change determined by Gradual lag angle change value.

tips.title: Change side tilt angle gradually along tool path
tips.body: Gradual side tilt angle change enables changing the side tilt angle for each cutting pass, with final change determined by Gradual side tilt angle change value.

tips.title: Limit ruled surface radius limit
tips.body: Ruled surface radius limit parameter limits the maximum radius of curvature for a surface to be considered as ruled.

tips.title: Allow flipping side direction for Zigzag cutting method
tips.body: Allow flipping side direction enables changing the direction of side tilting for tool paths generated with the Zigzag cutting method.

tips.title: Align tool axis to planar surface edges
tips.body: Align tool axis to planar surface edges option aligns the orientation at the start and end of the blade to its surface edge.

tips.title: Improve side tilt definition for twisted surfaces
tips.body: Improve side tilt definition for twisted surfaces option optimally adjusts tool tilting for swarf machining of twisted ruled surfaces.

tips.title: Set tool axis control to orthogonal to cut direction at each position
tips.body: Ensure that the side tilting plane is perpendicular to the tool path direction for every cutting position.

tips.title: Configure tool axis control to use user-defined direction
tips.body: Specify a reference vector in the Direction dialog box to determine the side tilting direction.

tips.title: Set tool axis control to orthogonal to edge curve
tips.body: Use this option when the Parallel to curve or Morph between two boundary curves strategies are employed.

tips.title: Define tilt lines for tool axis control
tips.body: Use the Tilt lines section to choose from a list of predefined geometries or define new ones by clicking.

tips.title: Set maximum snap distance for tilt lines
tips.body: Configure the Tilting lines maximum snap distance parameter to define the maximum distance between tilt line end points and the machining contour.

tips.title: Tilt tool axis to surface normal by fixed angle
tips.body: This option tilts the tool in a plane defined by a surface normal at the contact point and a specified tilt axis.

tips.title: Define fixed tilt angle for tool axis control
tips.body: Set the Fixed tilt angle parameter to define the angle of the tool tilting from the surface normal in the tilting plane.

tips.title: Enable rotary angle for tool axis control
tips.body: Use this option to have a fixed side angle relative to a fixed axis and also a fixed lead or a rotary angle around the fixed axis.

tips.title: Flip tool axis direction in tilting plane relative to surface normal
tips.body: This option enables you to reverse the tool axis direction in the tilting plane relative to the surface normal.

tips.title: Maintain tilt angle throughout the operation
tips.body: This option enables you to maintain the tilt angle throughout the entire machining process.

tips.title: Tilt tool axis through a specified point
tips.body: Define the direction of the tool axis by a vector from the contact point on the drive surface to the specified point.

tips.title: Set additional tilting from the calculated vector through a specified point
tips.body: Use this option to define an additional tilt angle from the vector through the defined point towards the chosen tilt axis.

tips.title: Define curve tilt type for tool axis control
tips.body: Set the Curve tilt type options to define how the end point of the tool axis vector is found on the Tilt curve.

tips.title: Define tool axis control parameters
tips.body: Set parameters such as Fixed tilt angle, Tilted to, and Point tilt type in the Tool axis control section.

tips.title: Choose existing or define new tilt curve
tips.body: Select an existing profile geometry for the tilt curve or create a new one using the Geometry Edit dialog box.

tips.title: Tilt tool axis through lines
tips.body: Define the tool tilting by a number of lines, changing gradually along the tool path to pass through defined lines.

tips.title: Tilt tool axis away from a point
tips.body: Direct the tool axis away from a specified point using a vector from the point to the tool contact point on the drive surface.

tips.title: Tilt tool axis away from a curve
tips.body: Intersect the tool axis with a specified Tilt curve, making it coincide with the vector directed from a point on the curve to the tool contact point.

tips.title: Set side tilt fanning distance
tips.body: Control the side tilting direction at the intersection of two surfaces with different isometric directions using the Side tilt fanning distance parameter.

tips.title: Define additional tool tilting from a curve
tips.body: Use the 'Fixed tilt angle' parameter to define an additional tilting angle from a specified tilt curve towards the chosen tilt axis.

tips.title: Adjust tool axis for impeller machining
tips.body: For impeller blades, use the 'Tilted relative to impeller machining layer' strategy with a normal tool axis to floor face of the impeller.

tips.title: Define local tilting for impellers
tips.body: Local tilting can be defined by specifying tilt lines and additional lead angles at the leading edge, splitter edge, and trailing edge.

tips.title: Set tool contact point for machining
tips.body: Choose the 'Auto' option to have InventorCAM automatically define the tool contact point, maintaining tangency with the drive surface.

tips.title: Define tool contact point manually
tips.body: Use the 'At Center', 'At Front', or 'At Radius' options to manually define the contact point between the tool and drive surface.

tips.title: Use axial shift for tool path offset
tips.body: Select 'Constant for each contour' to keep the offset value constant along the axis, or 'Gradual for all cuts' to gradually increase the offset.

tips.title: Smooth tool path with damp option
tips.body: Enable the 'Damp' check box to smooth the tool path, avoiding sharp jumps and reducing vertical jumps.

tips.title: Define approach/retract method for tool path
tips.body: Choose 'From clearance area', 'Use retract distance', or 'Use safety distance' to specify the starting level of the approach movement.

tips.title: Direct approach for first entry
tips.body: Select the 'Direct' option to start machining directly in the first point of the tool path without any approach movement.

tips.title: Use incremental clearance area for approach
tips.body: Choose 'From incremental clearance area' to retract to an incremental clearance plane, reducing retracts and machining time.

tips.title: Define last exit for tool path
tips.body: Choose 'Direct' to finish machining directly in the last point of the tool path without any retreat movement, or 'Back to clearance area' to return to the clearance area.

tips.title: Use safety distance for retreat movement
tips.body: Retreat to the Safety distance level after cutting passes.

tips.title: Back to clearance through tube center for tubular parts
tips.body: Use this option when machining port and tubular parts to exit through the tube center.

tips.title: T o incremental clearance area for gap areas
tips.body: Move back to the incremental clearance area when a gap is detected.

tips.title: Define home position for tool path linking
tips.body: Set the Home position to define a point where the tool returns after the last exit.

tips.title: Define coordinates for home position
tips.body: Specify the X, Y, Z coordinates for the Home position in the simulation.

tips.title: Direct movement for small gaps
tips.body: Use direct movement for gap areas smaller than the specified size.

tips.title: Blend spline for large gaps
tips.body: Use a blend spline for gap areas larger than the specified size.

tips.title: Safety distance for gap areas
tips.body: Perform a retract movement to the Safety distance before moving directly to the next segment.

tips.title: Clearance area for gap areas
tips.body: Move through the Clearance area between pass segments.

tips.title: Follow surfaces for gap areas
tips.body: Maintain tangency between pass segments in the gap area.

tips.title: Use Lead-In for approach movement
tips.body: Perform the approach movement to the drive surface using specified Lead-In options.

tips.title: Use Lead-Out for retreat movement
tips.body: Perform the retreat movement using specified Lead-Out options.

tips.title: Use Lead-In/Out for both approach and retreat movements
tips.body: Perform both the approach and retreat movements using specified Lead-In and Lead-Out options.

tips.title: Direct movement for small movements between passes
tips.body: Use direct movement for movements between passes smaller than the specified size.

tips.title: Safety distance for movements between passes
tips.body: Perform a retract movement to the Safety distance before moving directly to the next pass.

tips.title: Clearance area for movements between passes
tips.body: Move through the Clearance area between passes.

tips.title: Follow surfaces for movements between passes
tips.body: Maintain tangency between pass segments during movements.

tips.title: Blend spline for movements between passes
tips.body: Connect pass segments with a blend spline.

tips.title: Use Lead-In for approach movement between passes
tips.body: Perform the approach movement to the drive surface after a gap using specified Lead-In options.

tips.title: Use Lead-Out for retreat movement between passes
tips.body: Perform the retreat movement using specified Lead-Out options.

tips.title: Use Lead-In/Out for both approach and retreat movements between passes
tips.body: Perform both the approach and retreat movements using specified Lead-In and Lead-Out options.

tips.title: Define default Lead-In/Out parameters
tips.body: Set the default parameters for approach and retreat movements.

tips.title: Choose type for approach/retreat movements
tips.body: Select one of the available types for approach and retreat movements.

tips.title: Use tangential line for approach/retreat
tips.body: InventorCAM performs the approach/retreat movement with a line tangential to the cutting pass.

tips.title: Use reverse tangential line for approach/retreat
tips.body: With this option, InventorCAM performs the approach/retreat movement with a line tangential to the cutting pass like the Tangential line option, but the direction of the approach/retreat line is reversed.

tips.title: Use orthogonal line for approach/retreat
tips.body: InventorCAM performs the approach/retreat movement with a line orthogonal to the cutting pass.

tips.title: Use position line for approach/retreat
tips.body: With this option, InventorCAM uses start point and direction as input and interpolates the tool positions from the line to the first and last point in the contour.

tips.title: Use vertical profile ramp for approach/retreat
tips.body: With this option, InventorCAM allows the lead to follow the tool path contour shape till it reaches a specified length and height.

tips.title: Use reverse vertical profile ramp for approach/retreat
tips.body: With this option, InventorCAM allows the lead to follow the tool path contour shape till it reaches the specified length and height.

tips.title: Use automatic arc for approach/retreat
tips.body: With this option, InventorCAM allows the lead to connect the contour tangentially to the retraction direction of the relinking.

tips.title: Flip approach/retreat arc for collision avoidance
tips.body: When regular approach/retreat by arc is obstructed, flip the defined approach/retreat arc to ensure unobstructed access.

tips.title: Control tool axis orientation during approach/retreat
tips.body: InventorCAM enables you to control the tool orientation during the approach/retreat movement.

tips.title: Set fixed tool axis orientation for approach/retreat
tips.body: The tool orientation is constant during the approach/retreat movement.

tips.title: Set variable tool axis orientation for approach/retreat
tips.body: The tool axis orientation continuously changes during the approach/retract movement.

tips.title: Limit total change of tool axis orientation for large moves
tips.body: InventorCAM enables you to limit the total change of tool axis orientation along a macro move with the Max. angle change parameter.

tips.title: Define dimensions of approach/retreat arc or line
tips.body: Width and Length parameters define the bounding rectangle surrounding the arc.

tips.title: Create fillet between line and contour for approach/retreat
tips.body: This option is available only if the chosen approach/retreat type is Orthogonal line, Tangential line, Reverse tang. line, Vertical profile ramp, and Reverse vertical profile ramp.

tips.title: Specify arc sweep/diameter for approach/retreat
tips.body: The Arc diameter parameter defines the diameter of the approach/retreat arc using the percentage of the Arc diameter to the Tool diameter.

tips.title: Define incremental height for approach/retreat movement
tips.body: The Height parameter enables you to define the incremental height of the first point of the approach/retreat movement.

tips.title: Define feed rate for approach/retreat movement
tips.body: This parameter enables you to define the feed rate for the approach/retreat movement.

tips.title: Use Same as Lead-In for Lead-Out definition
tips.body: The Same as Lead-In option enables you to use the defined Lead-In strategy for the Lead-Out definition.

tips.title: Enable/Disable gouge checking parameters
tips.body: Select the Enable/Disable check box to activate a set of gouge checking parameters.

tips.title: Choose tool and tool holder components for gouge check
tips.body: InventorCAM enables you to choose both tool and tool holder components to perform the gouge check for them.

tips.title: Choose model faces for gouge checking
tips.body: The Geometry section enables you to choose the model faces for which the gouge checking is performed.

tips.title: Choose check surfaces for gouge checking
tips.body: This option enables you to choose a number of non-drive surfaces on the model as the Check surfaces and perform the gouge checking for them.

tips.title: Define stock to leave for check surfaces
tips.body: This parameter enables you to define an allowance for the Check surfaces.

tips.title: Define tolerance for check surfaces
tips.body: This parameter enables you to define the accuracy of the gouge checking for the Check surfaces.

tips.title: Avoid collisions by retracting tool
tips.body: When a possible collision is detected, the tool performs a retract movement at the automatically calculated distance and then 'flows' around check faces avoiding the gouge.

tips.title: Create a flat surface for tool path definition
tips.body: Instead of selecting all faces as drive faces, create a new flat surface to define the tool path and project it onto the model faces.

tips.title: Enable tool path projection on required 3D geometry
tips.body: Check the 'Drop tool down wherever needed' box to activate projection of the tool path onto the required 3D geometry.

tips.title: Remove areas where tool drop fails
tips.body: Check the 'Remove areas where tool drop fails' box to exclude areas from the tool path where projection cannot be performed.

tips.title: Smooth retract movements to avoid sudden axis jumps
tips.body: Check the 'Smooth retracts' box and set the 'Smooth distance field' to define the start distance of smoothing.

tips.title: Define retract direction along various axes and planes
tips.body: Choose from options like 'Along +Z', 'Along ZX plane', 'Optimized in ZX plane', etc., to define the retract direction.

tips.title: Project tool path from drive surface to check surface
tips.body: Click the 'Advanced' button and select 'Project tool on direction wherever needed' to project the tool path onto a new flat surface.

tips.title: Define maximum outward and inward distances for projection
tips.body: Use the 'Maximum outward distance' and 'Maximum inward distance' fields to define the outwards or inwards maximum projection depth.

tips.title: Reverse projection direction of tool path
tips.body: Check the 'Reverse' box to reverse the projection direction of the tool path.

tips.title: Avoid collisions by tilting the tool
tips.body: Use the 'Tilt tool' option to avoid collisions by tilting the tool in various directions.

tips.title: Define tilting direction and angle range
tips.body: Use the 'Angles to avoid collisions' dialog box to define the tilting direction and specify the range for the tilting angle.

tips.title: Smooth tool path and side tilt angle
tips.body: Use the 'Smoothing' button to smooth the tool path in its cutting direction and the side tilt angle.

tips.title: Define distance between collision point and tool tilting start
tips.body: Use the 'Distance' field in the 'Use blend section' to define the distance between the collision point and the point where the tool tilting starts.

tips.title: Define minimum and maximum angles for tool axis orientations
tips.body: Select an appropriate rotary axis, then define tilt and rotary angle limits based on collision avoidance needs.

tips.title: Use blend section to define collision point and tool tilting start
tips.body: Set the distance between collision point and tool tilting start for smoother operation.

tips.title: Enable automatic tilting to avoid collisions
tips.body: InventorCAM automatically guides the tool to avoid collisions based on defined parameters.

tips.title: Select preference for tilting the tool to avoid collisions
tips.body: Choose between Equal tilting, Rotary tilt, or Tilt options based on specific needs.

tips.title: Change fixed tilt angle for specific tool axis control strategies
tips.body: Modify the fixed tilt angle based on selected tool axis control page options.

tips.title: Rotate around Z-axis for specific tool axis control strategies
tips.body: Adjust the tilting angle around the Z-axis based on selected tool axis control page options.

tips.title: Trim and relink toolpath to avoid collisions
tips.body: InventorCAM trims the segments of the tool path where collisions are detected and updates the tool path accordingly.

tips.title: Report collisions during simulation
tips.body: Check only for collision between the tool and check faces without trying to avoid them; a warning message is displayed.

tips.title: Define clearance offsets for arbor and tool holder
tips.body: Choose between Cylindric or Conical shape of the tool holder, arbor, and tool shaft clearance.

tips.title: Set air move safety distance
tips.body: Define the minimal distance between the clearance area and the Drive surface.

tips.title: Handle remaining collisions for links and contours independently
tips.body: Choose to keep colliding contours, trim and relink them, or stop tool path calculation based on Gouge check strategy.

tips.title: Report remaining collisions after gouge checking
tips.body: Generate a report about possible collisions that remain in the tool path after gouge checking.

tips.title: Check gouge between tool path positions for 5-axis operations
tips.body: Enable checking for possible collisions of the tool and tool holder with drive and check surfaces during 5-axis movement.

tips.title: Extend tool to infinity for collision check
tips.body: Consider the tool as being extended to infinity during collision check to ensure all active surfaces are checked.

tips.title: Check tip radius for contours and links during collision check
tips.body: Enable checking the tip radius for collisions for cutting tool path (contours) and defined links.

tips.title: Check link motions for collision
tips.body: Automatically performs gouge checking for link movements to avoid collisions.

tips.title: Trim contour for safe retract
tips.body: Enables tool to retract without collisions when checking link motions.

tips.title: Check link motions against boundaries
tips.body: Ensures links remain within constraint boundaries or use clearance area links.

tips.title: Define boundary geometry
tips.body: Create new boundary geometries or choose existing ones for link motion checks.

tips.title: Use Multi-passes for roughing and finishing
tips.body: Generates multiple passes with specified number of roughing and finishing layers.

tips.title: Define roughing and finishing passes
tips.body: Set number of roughing and finishing passes and their spacing.

tips.title: Sort passes by slices or levels
tips.body: Choose sorting method for generated passes: Slices or Passes.

tips.title: Define machining angle XY change
tips.body: Set gradual change of machining angle for multi-cut roughing.

tips.title: Use Depth cuts for rough and finish machining
tips.body: Perform rough and finish cuts in the direction of tool axis.

tips.title: Define rough and finishing passes for depth cuts
tips.body: Set number of roughing and finishing passes and their spacing.

tips.title: Apply depth cuts to entire tool path or first pass
tips.body: Choose whether depth cut parameters apply to the whole tool path or just the first pass.

tips.title: Use ramp for single spiral cutting pass
tips.body: Convert multiple separate passes into a single taper spiral cutting pass.

tips.title: Define rotation parameters for rotating strategy
tips.body: Set axis, base point, number of steps, start angle, and rotation angle.

tips.title: Define translation parameters for rotating strategy
tips.body: Set start distance and step over distance for transformed pattern.

tips.title: Sort tool paths by different criteria
tips.body: Options include Complete tool path, Passes, Slices, and Partial tool path.

tips.title: Define stock trimming for avoiding air cuts
tips.body: Use the Stock definition dialog box to define trimming of Sim. 5-axis passes.

tips.title: Use updated stock model for avoiding air cuts
tips.body: InventorCAM calculates the Updated Stock model after all previous operations and compares it with operation target geometry.

tips.title: Mirror tool paths around selected axis and base point
tips.body: Use the Mirror option to create a mirror image of the tool path.

tips.title: Define plunging parameters for 5-axis machining
tips.body: Set Step length, Plunge height, and Slide length in the Plunging dialog box.

tips.title: Perform spiral machining for pocketing
tips.body: Check the Spiral machining option in the Morph pocket dialog box to generate a spiral tool path.

tips.title: Define area roughing parameters for impeller machining
tips.body: Set Rotary axis around, Spiral machining, Initial tool path, and Area roughing tool path in the Area roughing dialog box.

tips.title: Define cutting method for area roughing
tips.body: Choose from One way (along rotary axis), One way (along reversed rotary axis), Zigzag, Zigzag (climb only), and Alternate direction to reduce path length.

tips.title: Calculate area roughing before or after collision control
tips.body: Choose Calculation applied option to define when the calculation of area roughing is performed.

tips.title: Enable extension at start and end for smoother finishing
tips.body: Set 'Extension at start' and 'Extension at end' parameters when using After collision control.

tips.title: Define cut length with percentage or curvature
tips.body: Use 'Trim cuts' parameter to define cut length: by % of cut length or when curvature exceeds tool diameter.

tips.title: Copy tool path pattern for collision-free upper cuts
tips.body: Enable 'Depth cuts' option to copy the tool path pattern into contact line direction, generating a collision-free pattern.

tips.title: Reverse tool path passes for roughing
tips.body: Select 'Reverse order of passes/tool path' in Sorting to perform passes in reverse order and direction.

tips.title: Connect slices by shortest distance for minimal travel
tips.body: Enable 'Connect slices by shortest distance' to minimize the distance between tool path slices.

tips.title: Choose linking type for multi-passes or depth cuts
tips.body: Select 'Links between passes' to define how the tool moves between cutting levels, options include Direct, Safety distance, Clearance area, Follow surfaces, Blend spline, and others.

tips.title: Use direct links for small movements
tips.body: Set 'Direct' link type for movements smaller than the specified Value.

tips.title: Use safety distance for large movements
tips.body: Set 'Safety distance' link type for movements larger than the specified Value.

tips.title: Use clearance area for precise approach and retreat
tips.body: Set 'Clearance area' link type to perform approach and retreat movements within a clearance area.

tips.title: Use follow surfaces for precise movement along drive surface
tips.body: Set 'Follow surfaces' link type to move the tool following the drive surface geometry at a specified offset.

tips.title: Use blend spline for collision-free links
tips.body: Set 'Blend spline' link type to create a collision-free link between contours using a spline tangential to the cutting passes.

tips.title: Use lead-in/lead-out strategies for precise movements
tips.body: Select 'Use Lead-In' and 'Use Lead-Out' to perform approach and retreat movements using pre-defined strategies.

tips.title: Optimize tool path for machine kinematics
tips.body: Use parameters on the Machine control page to optimize tool paths according to your CNC-machine's kinematics and special characteristics.

tips.title: Select angle pair for 5-axis machines
tips.body: Choose the 'Angle pairs' option to map the tool axis vector into two different angle pairs, with options like Minimum angle change and Start angle type.

tips.title: Use machine limits to avoid exceeding machine boundaries
tips.body: Select 'Machine limits' to use the machine's defined limits for translation and/or rotation movements, with options like No limits, Translation limits, Rotation limits, or All limits.

tips.title: Handle poles in 5-axis machines
tips.body: Understand that in a 5-axis machine, tool axis orientation can be described by two angle pairs except when rotating around a coordinate system axis.

tips.title: Freeze Angle around Pole
tips.body: Tool axis orientation is parallel to the rotation axis in pole areas.

tips.title: Use Rotation Angle around Pole
tips.body: Adjusts linear axes with rotation axes to stay within linear axis limits.

tips.title: Linear interpolation of Rotation Angle around Pole
tips.body: Tool can be vertical with any C-axis value if X- and Y-axis values are changed accordingly.

tips.title: Smooth interpolation of Rotation Angle around Pole
tips.body: Similar to linear interpolation but with smooth change at first and second non-vertical positions.

tips.title: Force table rotations
tips.body: Used on 4-axis, 5-axis table-table, and 5-axis head-table machines to handle orientations closer to a 3-axis tool path.

tips.title: Pole angle tolerance value
tips.body: Defines the maximal angular deviation of the tool axis from the rotation axis to consider it parallel.

tips.title: Move list writer option
tips.body: Enables defining angle limits for output tool paths to generate compatible G-code with CNC-machine controllers.

tips.title: First rotation axis angle limit/Second rotation axis angle limit
tips.body: Define the angle limits for the first and rotational axes respectively.

tips.title: Angle change parameter
tips.body: Defines the maximal angle variation between two successive tool positions.

tips.title: Retract distance parameter
tips.body: Determines the distance of the retract movement when angle change exceeds Angle change value.

tips.title: Retract tool to maximum
tips.body: Performs a retract movement to the maximal distance defined by machine limit when angle change exceeds Angle change value.

tips.title: Rewind method
tips.body: Beneficial when tool reaches rotational axis limits, retracts to a safe area and performs a rotational back to initial limit.

tips.title: Interpolation angle step parameter
tips.body: Enables interpolation of angular movements at each angle defined by the Interpolation angle step parameter.

tips.title: Interpolation for distance parameter
tips.body: Enables interpolation for linear tool movements at each distance defined by the Interpolation angle step parameter.

tips.title: Tool center based calculation option
tips.body: Enables tool path calculation based on the tool center for Constant-Z machining.

tips.title: Smooth surface normals option
tips.body: Enables smoothing of drive surface normals based on the Smoothing threshold value.

tips.title: Max. angle step for rotation axis parameter
tips.body: Limits the rotation angle of the machine head to a specified value measured from the last tool path point.

tips.title: Custom triangulation option
tips.body: Enables higher rate of accurate triangulation using 5-Axis triangulation method.

tips.title: Rotary Finishing operation
tips.body: Generates rotary tool paths to mill parts on a 4-axis machine, suitable for cylindrical parts like bottle molds and core.

tips.title: Adding a Rotary Finishing Operation
tips.body: Right-click the Operations header in InventorCAM Manager and choose the Rotary Finishing 4x command from the Add Milling Operation submenu.

tips.title: Rotary Finishing dialog box
tips.body: Displays the Rotary Finishing dialog box for defining operation parameters.

tips.title: CoordSys page of Rotary Finishing
tips.body: Similar to the Coordsys page of other Sim 5-Axis Milling operations.

tips.title: Geometry page of Rotary Finishing
tips.body: Defines the machining surfaces and strategies for the operation.

tips.title: Along rotary axis strategy
tips.body: Tool path is created along the axis of rotation.

tips.title: Around rotary axis strategy
tips.body: Tool path is created around the axis of rotation.

tips.title: Machining surfaces in Rotary Finishing
tips.body: The entire model or any surface(s) of the design model can be used as machining surfaces.

tips.title: Offset parameter in Rotary Finishing
tips.body: Defines the offset for the machining surfaces.

tips.title: Side shift parameter in Rotary Finishing
tips.body: Shifts the tool to the side of the part, using the front part for contact.

tips.title: Set machining area limits
tips.body: Choose 'User-defined' for custom start and end values.

tips.title: Define angular limits for machining area
tips.body: Set start and end angles to limit tool path between specific angles.

tips.title: Select appropriate tools for Rotary finishing
tips.body: Use End Mill, Bull Nose Mill, Ball Nose Mill, Taper Ball Nose, Lollipop Mill, or Barrel Shape tools.

tips.title: Control feed and motion in Rotary finishing
tips.body: Feed control tab is available with Feed zone control and Rapid motion in G1 mode.

tips.title: Set clearance type for Rotary finishing
tips.body: Cylinder is the only option available as the Clearance Type.

tips.title: Define surface quality parameters in Rotary finishing
tips.body: Set cut tolerance, maximum step over, scallop, and step angle.

tips.title: Choose cutting method for Rotary finishing
tips.body: Options include Zigzag, One way, and Spiral.

tips.title: Set direction for closed cuts in Rotary finishing
tips.body: Options are Clockwise and Counterclockwise.

tips.title: Control point distribution in Rotary finishing
tips.body: Enable/Disable options for maximum and minimum distance.

tips.title: Set maximum angle step for interpolation
tips.body: Define the maximal allowed angle change between tool axes.

tips.title: Convert HSM operation to 5-Axis Milling
tips.body: Choose 'HSM to Sim. 5-Axis Milling' from Add Milling Operation submenu.

tips.title: Define conversion technology type
tips.body: Choose between Conversion and Autotilt.

tips.title: Set cut tolerance for conversion
tips.body: Define the tool path accuracy.

tips.title: Set arc approximation tolerance for conversion
tips.body: Define the tolerance for creating G2/G3 GCode output.

tips.title: Choose conversion link type
tips.body: Select between using original source links or relinking the tool path.

tips.title: Set contour feed rates for conversion
tips.body: Choose to use converted operation's feed rates or define new ones.

tips.title: Set workpiece clearance for Autotilt technology
tips.body: Define the offset that has been used for creating the 3-axis tool-path.

tips.title: Keep or change feed rates after conversion
tips.body: Choose to keep original feed rates or change them to machining feed.

tips.title: Maintain or filter tool path points during conversion
tips.body: Choose to keep input points or apply a filter for conversion.

tips.title: Define Machine Coordinate System
tips.body: Choose an existing Coordinate System or define a new one using the CoordSys Manager dialog box.

tips.title: Select Geometry for Drilling
tips.body: Choose an existing geometry from the list or create a new one using the New button.

tips.title: Filter Drills
tips.body: Use the Filter dialog box to filter drills by Hole type, diameter, and height range.

tips.title: Define Tool for Drilling
tips.body: Select a compatible tool type such as End, Bull Nose & Ball Nose Mills, Drill, Centre, Chamfer & Spot Drill, Reamer, Bore, Tap, Taper, Slot, Lollipop, Dovetail & Face Mill.

tips.title: Set Clearance Area
tips.body: Define the Clearance area type as Automatic, Plane, Cylinder, or Sphere based on part geometry and tool path type.

tips.title: Set Safety and Retract Distance
tips.body: Define the Safety distance for approach movement and Retract distance for rapid descent in the Clearance area.

tips.title: Edit Drill Geometry
tips.body: Use the Depth Edit dialog box to choose drills and modify geometrical parameters.

tips.title: Sort Drilling Sequence
tips.body: Define the order of drilling positions sorting using options like Automatic, Plane, Cylinder, or Sphere.

tips.title: Sorting of cylindrical drilling patterns
tips.body: InventorCAM uses the center point around which the cylindrical pattern is defined to sort drilling positions.

tips.title: Start angle for cylindrical drilling
tips.body: The Start angle parameter defines the angle at which the start position will be chosen.

tips.title: Tolerance for cylindrical sorting
tips.body: The Tolerance value determines if drilling positions belong to the same angle group.

tips.title: Change sorting center for cylindrical drilling
tips.body: The Change sorting center button enables you to change the pattern center location by picking on the model.

tips.title: Cylindrical sorting methods
tips.body: InventorCAM provides several cylindrical sorting methods including start at minimal Z and angle, increasing/decreasing order of Z.

tips.title: Define drilling cycle type
tips.body: Refer to InventorCAM Milling Help for details on available drilling cycles.

tips.title: Use cycle for G-code output
tips.body: Selecting this check box produces canned cycles in the G-code; unselecting it results in linear movements.

tips.title: SWARF Machining strategy for steep areas
tips.body: Machining is performed by the tool side, providing better surface quality with fewer cuts.

tips.title: Add SWARF Machining Operation
tips.body: Right-click Operations header in Inventor Manager and choose SWARF Machining command.

tips.title: Synchronize with tilt lines strategy
tips.body: Tool axis aligned to Tilt lines along Upper and Lower curves, automatically interpolating between them.

tips.title: Synchronize with upper/lower curves strategy
tips.body: Tool path divided along Upper and Lower curves into equidistant steps, tool axis aligned to each step.

tips.title: Synchronize with main direction strategy
tips.body: Tool path generated with tool axis as close to defined axis as possible, minimizing tilting around axis.

tips.title: Automatic strategy for swarf surfaces
tips.body: Tool placed on swarf surface to achieve line contact, requires selecting Swarf surfaces in Part definition.

tips.title: Shortest distance strategy for curves
tips.body: Tool aligned with upper and lower curves using shortest distance between them.

tips.title: Normal to guide curve strategy
tips.body: Tool driven normal to defined curve and surfaces, edges automatically extracted from selected part surfaces.

tips.title: Synchronize with ISO curves strategy
tips.body: Tool guided to follow ISO curves of a nurbs surface, useful for creating rounded shapes.

tips.title: Drop tool to floor option
tips.body: Tool retracts or follows the floor surface when there is a gap between machining and floor surfaces.

tips.title: Adjust feed rates on edges
tips.body: Feed rate reduced on small inner and outer corners to prevent overcutting.

tips.title: Adjust feed rates for fanning
tips.body: Feed rate calculated on upper curve instead of tool tip to avoid acceleration due to fanning.

tips.title: Adjust feed rates for cutting depth
tips.body: Feed rate reduced according to cutting depth, slower in deep areas.

tips.title: Rapid motion in G1 mode
tips.body: G-code does not contain G0 commands for rapid movements, using feed rate defined by Rapid feed rate parameter.

tips.title: Tangentially extend tool path at start and end
tips.body: Options include Automatic, Align to edges, and StartEndwith angle.

tips.title: Control tool axis orientation during SWARF machining
tips.body: Options include Output format, Rotary axis, Tilt angle, Locked at angle, and Flip.

tips.title: Define corner machining strategies for inner corners
tips.body: Options include Sharp corner and Round corner with fillet radius.

tips.title: Define corner machining strategies for outer corners
tips.body: Options include Roll around, Sharp corner, and Loop with loop radius.

tips.title: Set maximum angle step for tool path
tips.body: Define the maximum allowed angle change between two consecutive points.

tips.title: Swap upper and lower curves for SWARF surfaces
tips.body: Available only if SWARF surfaces are defined in the Part definition section.

tips.title: Apply axial damping to tool path
tips.body: Smooths the tool path to avoid vertical jumps.

tips.title: Set fanning distance for tool path
tips.body: Avoids tool stopping at the shorter curve by setting a distance.

tips.title: Check for collisions during SWARF machining
tips.body: Options include Guide curves only, Swarf surfaces, Additional surfaces, and Swarf & additional surfaces.

tips.title: Handle collisions by degouging
tips.body: Completely degouges the surface for a collision-free tool path.

tips.title: Handle collisions by balancing gouge and excess material
tips.body: Equalizes the amount of rest material and gouging.

tips.title: Handle collisions by avoiding with relinking
tips.body: Trims the colliding tool path segments with selected collision check surfaces.

tips.title: Handle collisions by retracting tool
tips.body: Retracts the tool from arbitrary check surfaces.

tips.title: Define tool clearance values
tips.body: Set offsets for arbor and tool holder to ensure a guaranteed clearance gap.

tips.title: Control rough Swarf Milling with pattern slices
tips.body: Perform machining in a single slice or multiple slices based on tool flute length.

tips.title: Define depth steps for rough Swarf Milling
tips.body: Options include By slice distance and By number of slices.

tips.title: Create tool path pattern for rough Swarf Milling
tips.body: Options include Morph, Step from top, and Step from bottom.

tips.title: Define tool path direction
tips.body: Choose 'Along contact line' for conical tools to avoid leaving the surface in upper cuts.

tips.title: Set tool damping for smoother paths
tips.body: Enable 'User-defined' in Tool Damping to smooth the path and avoid vertical jumps.

tips.title: Control tool shift for each slice
tips.body: Select 'Constant for each slice' to perform axial shifts with a constant value per slice.

tips.title: Specify start and end values for gradual tool shift
tips.body: For 'Gradual for each slice', set a start value (From) and an end value (To).

tips.title: Define number of layers for pattern layers
tips.body: Set the Number of layers to define multiple offset layers from slices.

tips.title: Specify layer distance for pattern layers
tips.body: Set the Layer distance to define the distance between multiple offset layers.

tips.title: Link passes by lanes or regions
tips.body: Choose 'Lanes' to link tool paths by contours on drive surfaces, or 'Regions' for independent machining.

tips.title: Link passes by layers or slices
tips.body: Select 'By layer' to perform all roughing and finishing offsets before moving to the next pass, or 'By slice' for each level.

tips.title: Mirror tool path around an axis
tips.body: Select 'Plane' and define the axis and base point for mirroring the tool path.

tips.title: Define geometry for Geodesic Machining
tips.body: Select 'Model' or 'Surfaces' to define the machining surfaces, and choose between 3 Axis and Multiaxis output.

tips.title: Set drive surface offset
tips.body: Define the machining allowance for the drive surface using the Drive surface offset parameter.

tips.title: Choose pattern type for Geodesic Machining
tips.body: Select 'Parallel to multiple curves' or 'Morph between two curves' based on the input curves.

tips.title: Define input type for Geodesic Machining
tips.body: Choose 'Automatic (center point)', 'Automatic (Machining area)', or 'Medial axis' to extract curves automatically.

tips.title: Set projection direction for machining
tips.body: Options include Machining direction, Surface normal, and User-defined (with vector coordinates).

tips.title: Define margin for offset from input curves
tips.body: Offset value must be positive or zero; negative values are not allowed.

tips.title: Select tool contact mode for Geodesic Machining
tips.body: Options include Tool tip and Tool center; Tool center allows collision-free paths in sharp corners.

tips.title: Define additional cut from boundary
tips.body: Create an additional cut tracking the same shape as the boundary with specified offset.

tips.title: Set side of guide curve for machining
tips.body: Options include Side One (inner portion) and Side Two (outer portion). Default is Side One.

tips.title: Control point distribution in tool path
tips.body: Options include Enable/Disable, Maximum distance, Minimum distance, and Deviation factor.

tips.title: Set axial shift for tool path
tips.body: Options include Constant for each contour, Gradual for all cuts, and Gradual for each contour.

tips.title: Define tool contact point during machining
tips.body: Options include Auto, At Center, At Radius, At Front, and At User-defined point.

tips.title: Simulate machine operation in InventorCAM
tips.body: Enable Machine simulation mode to perform machining simulation and tool path verification.

tips.title: Use gradient color scales to analyze tool paths
tips.body: Segments marked red indicate plunging in the tool axis direction, orange for lag angle orientation, gray for normal orientation, light green for lead angle orientation, and green for retraction along the tool axis.

tips.title: Adjust tool axis angle range for specific colors in simulation
tips.body: Click 'Adjust Axis Pole' to define a specific tool axis angle range and view the tool path in corresponding colors.

tips.title: Analyze tool path length for stability
tips.body: The 'Tool Path Length' parameter in the Analysis window helps identify if tool path points are equally distributed on the workpiece to ensure stability.

tips.title: Edit CNC-machine definitions using the right-click menu
tips.body: InventorCAM allows managing CNC-machine components using a right-click menu available on each component.

tips.title: Set stop conditions for simulation
tips.body: The Simulation window enables setting stop conditions based on program, cutting, or tool tip.

tips.title: Customize Quick Access Toolbar for quick tasks
tips.body: The Customize Quick Access Toolbar allows adding one-click access to frequently used commands.

tips.title: Perform solid verification during machine simulation
tips.body: InventorCAM allows performing solid verification of material cutting process using dynamic subtraction of tool solid model from stock solid model.

tips.title: Load target model with CAM or CAD tolerance during simulation
tips.body: The 'Target loading' option enables setting the mode of target model loading, either with CAM tolerance for precise results or CAD tolerance for faster loading.

tips.title: Define CNC-machine model
tips.body: Create STL files for each component using an output coordinate system at the CNC-machine origin.

tips.title: Set initial state of components
tips.body: Place all components in their initial state (C=0, B=0 for rotational axes; X=0, Y=0, Z=0 for translational axes).

tips.title: Export CNC-machine model
tips.body: Export the CNC-machine model into STL format using the defined coordinate system and without translation.

tips.title: Define CNC-machine properties
tips.body: Open the Machine window to list all machine components in hierarchical order and divide them into categories.

tips.title: Start CNC-machine definition
tips.body: Copy the provided files (table_table_exercise.vmid, table_table_exercise.prp, FANUC.gpp) into GPPtool and Machine Simulation folders.

tips.title: Load Machine ID file
tips.body: Open the Machine ID Editor and load the table_table_exercise.vmid file.

tips.title: Open Machine Simulation
tips.body: In the MachSimIntegration window, open Machine Simulation to define a new CNC-Machine.

tips.title: Create new machine definition
tips.body: Select the Edit Machine icon and click New Machine to create a new, empty unnamed machine.

tips.title: Name the machine
tips.body: Enter a name for the new machine in the bottom of the window.

tips.title: Create Machine definition folder
tips.body: In the XML folder, create a new folder with the name of your CNC-Machine and assign it to the Machine Simulation Name parameter.

tips.title: Save machine definition
tips.body: Click Save Machine As to save the empty machine definition and copy all STL files into the Machine definition folder.

tips.title: Define workpiece transform object
tips.body: Enables adding a workpiece transform object in machine kinematics.

tips.title: Define holder transform object
tips.body: Enables adding a holder transform object in machine kinematics.

tips.title: Define user-defined transform object
tips.body: Enables adding a customized transform object in machine kinematics.

tips.title: Select dynamic element in machine kinematics
tips.body: Enables selecting a dynamic element like Tool Spindle Revolving Group, Single Workpiece Set, or Single Tool Set.

tips.title: Define workpiece spindle revolving group
tips.body: Defined under the spindle rotation axis, contains Fixture and Geometry objects for clamp system.

tips.title: Define tool spindle revolving group
tips.body: Defined at the end in kinematic branch, contains Geometry objects rotating with tool and Tool Set.

tips.title: Define single workpiece set
tips.body: Enables adding a workpiece set (workpiece adapter containing workpiece, fixture, stock, initial stock and tool path).

tips.title: Define single tool set
tips.body: Enables adding a tool set (holder transform containing the tool with all its parts: holder, arbor, shaft and flute).

tips.title: Define workpiece element
tips.body: Enables defining a workpiece (Target part) element.

tips.title: Define fixture element
tips.body: Enables defining a stock fixture or chuck and jaws (from a clamp system). Usually, the jaws are defined under translation or rotation axis.

tips.title: Define stock element
tips.body: Enables defining a stock fixture or chuck and jaws (from a clamp system). Usually, the jaws are defined under translation or rotation axis.

tips.title: Define initial stock element
tips.body: Enables defining an initial stock element.

tips.title: Define toolpath element
tips.body: Enables defining a tool path line.

tips.title: Define tool element
tips.body: Enables defining the tool element like Flute, Shaft, Arbor and Holder.

tips.title: Add geometry in machine kinematics
tips.body: Enables adding one or more geometries in the machine kinematics.

tips.title: Add tailstock object in machine kinematics
tips.body: Enables adding a tailstock object in the machine kinematics.

tips.title: Define collision checking elements
tips.body: Enables defining the collision checking elements in two groups, checked with respect to all components from another group.

tips.title: Define machine housing
tips.body: Enables making any geometry as machine housing geometry, automatically renaming it.

tips.title: Define coordinate transformation
tips.body: Enables defining the transformation of a coordinate system relative to the CNC-machine coordinate system.

tips.title: Define translational axis
tips.body: Enables defining the moving components of the CNC-machine according to their hierarchical dependencies.

tips.title: Define spindle unit properties
tips.body: Enables defining the properties of the spindle unit, including its movement along the Z-axis.

tips.title: Define Y-axis properties
tips.body: Enables defining the properties of the Y-axis, including its movement and direction.

tips.title: Define translational axis parameters
tips.body: Use Axis Control tab to check translational movements of defined geometry along the axis.

tips.title: Set direction and center point for rotational axis
tips.body: For B-axis rotation, set Direction: -1.00000 0.00000 0.00000 and Center point: 0.00000 0.00000 -30.00000.

tips.title: Define limits for rotational axis
tips.body: Set Min Limit: -100° and Max Limit: 100°.

tips.title: Define direction and center point for rotary table
tips.body: For C-axis rotation, set Direction: 0.00000 0.00000 -1.00000 and Center point: 0.00000 0.00000 0.00000.

tips.title: Define limits for rotary table
tips.body: Set Min Limit: -1000° and Max Limit: 1000°.

tips.title: Define tool geometry and kinematic relationship
tips.body: Tool with holder is mounted on the CNC-Machine spindle unit (Z-axis). Tool item precedes coordinate system transformations.

tips.title: Define magazine components
tips.body: Magazine contains features like CS1, TH_FXx, Target_Stock1, and fxt1. Number of Target_Stocks must be two times the number of tables.

tips.title: Enable collision control
tips.body: Collision control detects and avoids collisions between CNC-machine components during machining.

tips.title: Define collision checking groups
tips.body: Blue and red panels represent two groups of elements for collision checking. '+' adds elements, '-' removes them.

tips.title: Configure XML file structure
tips.body: XML file includes machine_data, view_transform, axis, and geometry elements with specified attributes.

tips.title: Define axis properties
tips.body: Axis can be rotation or translation, with direction, minvalue, maxvalue, valuetype, and initial_value attributes.

tips.title: Add geometries to axis tree
tips.body: Geometries in *.stl format can be added with properties like name, geo, clrr, clrg, clrb, alpha, reflectivity, and objtype.

tips.title: Define transform properties
